notices.text: I received the Society for the Advancement of American Philosophy's Harris-Jones Prize for “Pluralism in Practice: Interpreting Black Feminism and Womanism Through Ella Lyman Cabot,” forthcoming in *The Pluralist*.
I received a Ralph Waldo Emerson Society Research Award supporting archival research in the Richard Clarke Cabot Papers at Harvard.
